review_summary: The readable report connects the alert rows to non-alert CBC telemetry for Discord-spawned reg.exe processes. It gives non-alert ACTION_WRITE_VALUE evidence for pid 2360 and pid 5504 Run\Discord adds, non-alert process/command evidence for pid 5424 querying HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\Discord, and parent Discord evidence for the reg.exe children. These recover all three C10 gold steps in order. The duplicate add, alert rows, parent/update context, Discord file activity, reg.exe module loads, and Discord network activity are denominator content; alert summary alone is not credited as non-alert evidence.

The report reconstructs two Sublime/plugin_host/cmd/python hello.py executions. The plugin_host-to-cmd parent evidence, cmd.exe /c python -u C:\Users\aalsahee\Documents\hello.py command lines, cmd-to-python parent/child evidence, and python.exe hello.py command lines recover C11-S01 through C11-S05 in order using non-alert EDR/NGAV evidence. The pip install xmltodict step C11-S06 is not recovered. Upstream Sublime/file/module/registry context and CBC alert rows are extra denominator content, and alert summaries are not credited by themselves.

The final reconstructed trees include two Sublime/plugin_host/cmd/python hello.py executions plus a separate explorer/cmd/python pip install xmltodict tree. The first Sublime chain recovers C11-S01 through C11-S05 in order with non-alert parent/child and command-line evidence, the repeated Sublime chain is duplicate matching content, and the separate python pip install xmltodict command recovers C11-S06. Userinit/explorer/Sublime upstream rows, repeated execution details, python module/script/file activity, and absence-of-network findings are denominator extras. No alert summary is credited as standalone non-alert evidence.
